name: io.github.bitrise-io/bitrise-mcp
title: Bitrise
description: Bitrise for AI agents: mobile CI/CD, Release Management, Insights and remote Dev Environments.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Bitrise Personal Access Token (format: 'Bearer YOUR_TOKEN') for MCP clients that don't yet support OAuth. Get your token from https://app.bitrise.io/me/account/security. Modern MCP clients (Claude, Cursor, VS Code, etc.) can leave this unset and the server will trigger the OAuth flow automatically on first tool use.

headers.name: x-bitrise-enabled-api-groups
headers.description: Comma-separated list of API groups to enable (e.g., 'apps,builds,workspaces' or 'dev-environments'). Leave empty to enable all groups.

headers.name: x-bitrise-workspace-id
headers.description: Optional. Default Bitrise workspace ID (slug) for the Dev Environments tools. If unset, a workspace_id tool argument is used, or the workspace is auto-detected when you belong to exactly one.
